high_level_description: stc brand style, a split-screen video call between two men, one gesturing expressively in a gaming room.

compositional_deconstruction.background: On the right, a room with gray walls decorated with framed artwork and posters, a purple couch with yellow pillows; on the left, a dark plain background.

elements.desc: A bald bearded man wearing a black shirt, shown on the left side of the split screen.
A young man wearing a yellow button-up shirt, gesturing with both hands raised, shown on the right side.
A camera lens, a tablet device, and a white plush toy on the desk in front of the speaker.
